title: CINDER confirmed flareEvent record
description: A confirmed flareEvent per PROTOCOL_DRAFT_v3 §0 / §4.6: a candidate signal event paired with a co-occurring care escalation event within the ±90-day window, surviving all M62/M63 governance gates. Carries domain shift bundle, escalation bundle, temporal offset, UC annotations, and M63 derivation chain reference.

flare_event_id.description: Stable identifier for this flareEvent record.

patient_id.description: Anonymized patient identifier from FORWARD export.

wave_date.description: ISO 8601 date of the wave anchoring this flareEvent.

domain_shift_bundle.description: PRO domain shifts that contributed to candidate signal status (§4.4).

stack_level.description: Number of PRO domains exceeding both MCID threshold and M3 Stability Band. Must be ≥ 2 by §4.4 candidate signal definition.

delta.description: Numerical change vs the patient's M2 baseline.

mcid_threshold.description: §4.4 MCID threshold for this instrument (HAQ-II 0.22, Pain VAS 20, Patient Global VAS 20, RAPID3 3.6).

exceeds_band.description: Whether the shift exceeds the M3-computed Stability Band for this patient × instrument.

escalation_bundle.description: Care escalation event(s) co-occurring with the candidate signal (§4.5).

primary_escalation_event_id.description: Reference to the primary escalation event in the source PTV.

escalation_category.description: M4.A escalation taxonomy category routed via M6.

secondary_escalation_event_ids.description: Other escalation events within the ±90-day window, recorded for audit but not the primary match (§4.6 secondary associations).

m6_arbitration_outcome.description: M6 arbitration label when the maintenance-vs-rescue rule applied (e.g., `maintenance-escalation-ambiguous-resolved`).

temporal_offset_days.description: Signed offset (PRO shift wave date) − (escalation date), in days. Within ±90 per §4.6 primary window.

window_size_days.description: Window applied for this match. 90 = primary; 60 / 120 = sensitivity analyses.

derivation_chain_id.description: Reference to the M63 GlassBox derivation chain record for this flareEvent.

applicable.description: False when the patient lacks smartphone follow-up data.

governance_status.description: M62 governance verdict for this flareEvent (§4.7 four outcomes).
